हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
A legendary warrior bears a cursed dragon arm that holds the power to either save or doom the world.
As kingdoms clash and betrayal brews, his quest for justice becomes a battle for destiny itself.
Revenge, magic, and fate intertwine in this epic saga of power and sacrifice.
